meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: 把内容编排成可翻页的 HyperFrames 幻灯片演示:每页可有要点分步出现、热点跳转分支和演讲者备注;也能把现有网页转成演示文稿。产出是可浏览的演示,不是视频。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片、演示文稿或翻页 deck 时触发;若只说要“演示文稿/把某页转成演示”,它会先和你确认再动手。

say.text: 把这 10 页提纲做成可翻页的幻灯片演示
say.note: 它会生成带导航的 HyperFrames 演示

say.text: 把我们的产品页转成演示文稿,保留原有动效
say.note: 会先确认再转换,保留页面行为

say.text: 给这页加个热点,跳到市场数据分支
say.note: 热点点击可跳转分支序列

howto.what_en: Arranges content into a navigable HyperFrames deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching hotspots, and presenter-mode speaker notes; can also convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a live deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks for a slideshow, presentation, or deck; for adjacent requests (like 'pitch deck' or 'convert this page') it asks for confirmation first.

say_en.text: Turn these 10 pages of outline into a navigable slideshow deck
say_en.note: It generates a HyperFrames deck with navigation

say_en.text: Convert our product page into a deck, keeping the motion
say_en.note: It confirms first, then preserves page behavior

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on this slide that jumps to the market data branch
say_en.note: Clicking the hotspot navigates to the branch sequence
